name: Pajson Agro India Ltd
title: Pajson Agro India Ltd - 544657 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capacity is expanding from 18,000 to 70,000 MT by FY30 with INR76 crore capex, but FY27 guides only ~20% growth from existing plant and a 15-16% EBITDA margin after an FX-driven fall from ~18%.

utilisation.quote: our 18,000 metric ton facility in Andhra Pradesh operated at a staggering 86% utilization capacity

capex.quote: the total capex for the new capacity is about INR76 crores and this is without the land

triggers.label: FY26 utilisation 86%
triggers.quote: our 18,000 metric ton facility in Andhra Pradesh operated at a staggering 86% utilization capacity

triggers.label: New capex INR76 cr for 35,000 MT
triggers.quote: the total capex for the new capacity is about INR76 crores and this is without the land

triggers.label: EBITDA margin 18% → 11% H2
triggers.quote: we expect the margins to be steady

triggers.label: Trade receivables up on credit to institutions
triggers.quote: with institutional customers there is more credit involved, hence we are seeing that our trade receivables have increased

guidance.quote: we expect another increment of about 20% to 22% -20% from the current levels
we are looking at 65% to 70% of capacity utilization and then reaching at 85%-90% utilization rate by the next fiscal
We have embarked on an ambitious Greenfield expansion to take our capacity to 70,000 metric tons by FY30.

red_flags.label: Margin fell ~18% to ~11% in H2; H2 PAT up only 8.97%
red_flags.quote: H2 saw some margins compression due to a spike in raw cashew nuts prices, forex, and global shipping disruptions

red_flags.label: Working capital and receivables rising; short-term advances INR31.95 cr
red_flags.quote: we are seeing that our trade receivables have increased

red_flags.label: Management inconsistency on margin trajectory
red_flags.quote: we expect the margins to be steady

evasions.quote: I cannot give the exact numbers but definitely a couple of percent.
we think that that is how it's going to balance it out itself

evasions.topic: Sourcing margin differential India vs Africa
evasions.quote: it is all about the pricing and all that you have to buy throughout the season
